column1: === MMORS WATER QUALITY ANALYTICS & PREPROCESSING REPORT ===

*Effective June 15, 2016, 15 days upon the publication of DENR Administration Order No. 08, Series of 2016: Water Quality Guidelines and General Effluent Standards of 2016, the primary parameters for ambient water monitoring aare: Dissolved Oxygen; pH; Temperature; Biochemical Oxygen Demand; Total Suspended Solids; Color; Chlorides; Phosphates; Nitrates; and Fecal Coliform.
0.048 mg/L is the smallest amount that can be detected for Nitrates
